scope: Real Chrome virtual camera/microphone, MediaRecorder, AudioContext resampling, JPEG capture and audio player; every API request intercepted as an explicit fixture; no provider calls
checks: Mount and incoming definition changes never start devices
Real browser recording resamples to server-accepted WAV and becomes a draft only
Cancel recording releases tracks and never transcribes
Closing while transcription is pending aborts and suppresses the late draft
Camera preview is explicit and sends no image until Describe
Stop speaking interrupts current audio; Stop camera revokes URLs and releases tracks
A delayed scene result cannot appear or play after Stop
Device permission denial keeps text available and camera off
Unmount, space change and logout all release camera tracks
Search cards keep text escaped and permit only canonical Open Library links
Automatic observation respects 15 seconds, one request at a time, eight frames and expiry
